title: The Summer of You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schoolers Chiharu and Wataru bond over a shared love of movies. When Chiharu confesses his feelings, Wataru says it does not bother him, and the two spend the summer visiting film locations, where Wataru begins to realize the feelings may be mutual. A short boys' love drama about first love and friendship.
life_message: Honest feelings, spoken and listened to with kindness, can turn a friendship into something deeper.
